Real generation; extraction is pinned to SCENE_NONE so only the scripted /cp writes move the story. The fixture switches settings.spikes.sp7Chance ON and its last step switches it OFF; after a FAILED run set it off by hand (st-eval: SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings.spikes = {sp7Chance:false}; saveSettingsDebounced()). PASS = the re-entered gate draws the same unit at the same boundary, the reply fires or skips the same way both times, and lock_gives is the same value both visits.
